The most football (soccer) Ligue 1 titles won by a player is 11, achieved by Marquinhos (Brazil, b. Marcos Aoás Corrêa) playing for Paris Saint-Germain in 2014–16, 2018–20 and 2022–26.
Centre-back Marquinhos claimed a record-extending 11th Ligue 1 title in 2025/26, in only his 13th season at Paris Saint-Germain.
